Concept sets of a recipe; OHDSI concept-set exchange

Source: R/recipe_v2.R
recipe_concept_sets.Rd

recipe_concept_sets() lists the recipe's registry concept sets. recipe_export_concept_sets() writes them as OHDSI (ATLAS) concept-set expressions; recipe_import_concept_sets() reads such expressions into the registry. Items must share their descendant/mapped flags; excluded items become the set's exclude (exact IDs, or a set with descendants when the excluded items include descendants). A nested exclusion (an excluded set with its own exclusion) has no OHDSI form and is refused on export rather than flattened.

Usage

recipe_concept_sets(recipe)

recipe_export_concept_sets(recipe, file = NULL)

recipe_import_concept_sets(recipe, x)

Arguments

recipe

An omop_recipe.

file

Optional path; NULL returns the JSON string.

x

A JSON string or file with one concept-set expression (list(items = ...)), a named list of them, or an ATLAS ConceptSets array (elements with name and expression).

Value

A named list of omop_concept_set objects, a JSON string, or the modified recipe.
